purpose: Matched-transformer head-to-head arm for the registered X40 v1 depth probe (the paper depth-comparability receipt).

control_arm_role: No new score prediction is registered for the control arm itself; it exists to satisfy the registration requirement of an identified fine-tuned transformer receipt under the exact update protocol. The X28E precedent for attention-native arms is OOD collapse (e97_native 4x/9x = .5/.5, accept recall 0).

protocol.permutations: epoch permutations dropping short remainder, rng np.random.default_rng(0), torch.manual_seed(0)
protocol.supervision: final-only binary margin BCE at the EOS position
protocol.head: new Embedding(5,256) replacing the LM embed; Linear(256,2) on the final hidden state; whole model fine-tuned
protocol.slot_budgets: S=2944 per head, native to the control tape cell (matched to the pure probe)
protocol.validation: every 500 updates on the fixed validation pool, latest-best (>=) selection
deviations: matched model is the X39 exact-exposure B64 hybrid control (tape_lm: five attention blocks + one X31 tape cell at block 2), not an X40 pure stack
replay check is X31 replay_present, not the pure stack 24-node count
